title: Aokie frame as delivered
description: One stored frame as the relay delivers it: an element of the frames page and the `data` of an SSE `frame` event (README section 4.14.5). `from`, `subjectId` and `grants` are the relay's own record of the verified sender (interpretation 38): nothing in `frame` can set them. `frame` is the document the sender posted, as an object.
